Offer letter for a new driver

Pay is {col:hiring.offered_rate} per loaded km, with a per diem and a share of waiting time as in our pay sheet. The planned first day is {col:hiring.start_date}.
Please bring your licence, medical card and bank details on the first day, and tell us your answer in writing.

The balance is repaid in full if the work ends before the advance is cleared.
Driver: {col:leave.driver}. Time off type: {col:leave.type}. From {col:leave.start} to {col:leave.end}, {col:leave.days} days. Status: {col:leave.status}.

Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: weekly km target, on-time goal, weekly driving hours, the bonus goals, employer cost and the planned driver cost per km.
Check Drivers, then Pay Rates: one row for each pay rate a driver has had. The earlier rate, the change and the cost per loaded km fill in.
Enter or paste one row per driver and week on Driver Settlements. Gross pay, net pay, pay per loaded km, driver cost per km and the payment check fill in by themselves.
Use Weekly Km per Driver and Per Diem Days to check the km against your target and the days away before you pay.
Log waiting time on Waiting Time Pay, and advances and deductions on Advances and Deductions. The balance owed and the weeks left fill in.
Every quarter fill Bonus Scheme and Driver Scorecard. The bonus, the score and the rank fill in from the limits you set.
Read Driver Profitability to see the revenue, the truck cost, the pay and the profit per week of each driver and truck.
Keep Office Payroll and Owner Pay current so the draw and the payroll cost show in the dashboard.
Plan Time Off, Home Time Plan and Driver Hours so you never promise a load to a driver who is away or out of hours.
Track applicants on Hiring Pipeline, courses on Training, turnover on Turnover, equipment on Driver Equipment and disputes on Pay Disputes.

Use the 14 calculators before you decide: settlement, pay per km, per diem, driver cost, bonus, waiting time share, driver profit, hours, hiring, advances, owner draw, turnover, a pay rise and a what-if grid.
Read Driver Pay Dashboard and Charts every week: pay, km, per diem, bonus, advances, profit, scorecards, payroll and hiring.
Never dispatch a truck on an expired paper again
every licence, registration, permit and policy shows days left and a flag that says start now, started or lapsed, so nothing rolls on an expired paper
One list of every paper that expires
63 items for drivers, trucks, trailers and the company with the status, the days to expiry and the date to start the renewal
licence, medical card and safety training of every driver with the number, the expiry and the driver phone for a reminder
Registrations and permits with renewal cost
the fee of every truck and trailer paper and the cash needed for the next 90 days
limit, deductible and premium of each cover with the premium per truck and per month and a renew-soon flag
monthly, trailer, annual and roadside inspections with defects, points and the next due date, flagged when no newer inspection was done
every roadside stop with the points of the truck, the average points per inspection and a clean-stop flag for each driver
days open, severity and a priority score for each defect, with a flag for a defect left open over your limit
cost, insurance paid and what you pay yourself for every accident, cargo damage and penalty, with the days it took to report
claimed, deductible and paid give the open amount and the days open, and a claim that waits too long shows as chase the insurer
what the customer claimed and what you agreed, the exposure after the deductible and a respond-now flag
incidents, roadside points and failed inspections are counted from the other pages and give each driver a score for the year and the last 12 months

The eight trucks with their driver and model year; compliance sheets pick the truck here and the driver and phone fill in from it.
The owner and seven drivers with the phone used by the message links; papers, incidents and safety records find the driver here.
Every licence, permit and policy with an expiry
One row per paper that expires: licences, medical cards, registrations, road permits, insurance and safety inspections; days to expiry and the status fill in.
Expiry calendar for the next 120 days
The items that expire within 120 days with the renewal fee and the day the renewal started; days left and a flag that says start now, started or lapsed fill in.
Driver licences, medical cards and training certificates
The licence, medical card and safety training certificate of every driver with the number and the expiry; days left, the status and the date to start the renewal fill in.
Truck and trailer registrations and road permits
Registration and road permit of every truck and the registration of every trailer with the fee; days left, the status and the renewal cost for the next 90 days fill in.
Insurance policies with premium per truck
Liability, cargo, damage and the other covers with limit, deductible, premium and dates; days to renewal, premium per truck and per month fill in, with the previous term kept.
Monthly checks, trailer checks, annual safety inspections and roadside stops with the result, defects and the date due next; a flag shows what is overdue.
Annual safety inspection of every truck and trailer
The last annual inspection of each truck and trailer with its result; the next due date, the days left and a check fill in, and the driver is found from the truck.
Roadside inspections with points and clean rate
Every roadside stop with the points and the result; a clean flag, the points of the truck and its average points per inspection fill in.
Defects found at inspections with the date fixed; the days open, a flag for a defect open over the limit and a repair priority fill in.
Every accident, cargo damage, roadside violation, penalty and loss with the cost and what the insurer paid; the out-of-pocket cost and the days to report fill in.
Insurance claims with open amount and days open
Claims sent to the insurer for incidents: the open amount, the days open and a chase flag fill in, so a claim that waits too long stands out.
Claims a customer made for damaged, short or warm cargo with what was agreed; the exposure after the deductible, the days open and a respond-now flag fill in.
Every near miss a driver reports with the place, what happened and the action; days open and a flag for a report open too long fill in.
Safety meetings with topics and actions
One row per safety meeting with the topic, the attendees and the actions agreed; attendance and the days to the next meeting fill in.
Each driver for the year to date and the last 12 months: incidents, roadside points and failed inspections are counted from the other pages and give a safety score.
The papers a carrier must be able to show: operating papers, contracts, policies, training records and loan papers with the owner, the expiry and where they are kept.
Straps, chains, tarps, extinguishers and first-aid kits
Five safety items on every truck with the date they were last checked and how often; the next check, the days left and a due flag fill in.
Renewal fees, inspection fees and training for each month with the number of trucks; the total and the cost per truck fill in.
